body_long:
The Hospitality Awards return on Monday 23 November 2026 at the InterContinental Paris Le Grand. Organised by Hospitality ON, the awards recognise initiatives by hotel groups and brands, and celebrate innovation in the industry.

Hospitality ON, the trade media behind the event, has covered the hotel industry for more than three decades through the HTR magazine, founded in 1994, and its successors.

## Why it matters

Unlike guides and readers' rankings, which judge individual hotels, the Hospitality Awards focus on groups and brands: new concepts, development strategies, service innovations and people initiatives. The ceremony also gathers a large part of the French hotel industry's leadership in one room, a few days before ILTM Cannes.

## The signal

The end of November is the industry's busiest moment for recognition and networking in France: the Hospitality Awards in Paris on 23 November, then ILTM Cannes from 30 November. For hotel executives, it is the right window to present projects and meet partners before the year-end.

We will publish the winners after the ceremony.
